inheritance: All discrete-module histories, global continuous-colour results, negative present-day abiotic species-proxy gates, chun Cirsium claim gate, JPN38/JPN29 provenance blockers, frozen Japan5, crop-harmonized H5 and expanded E6 results remain in force unless explicitly updated below.

existing_cohort_audit.admission_rule: >=2 Japan-local colour-usable strict-spatial observations AND >=2 distinct analysis cells; exact concept identity

japan7_source_balanced_history.interpretation: The global species-proxy anti-phylogenetic lightness pattern does not replicate in the Japanese radiation when local phenotype evidence is restricted to a fully source-balanced seven-concept Azami production cohort. The observed sign is positive and remains positive under every concept leave-one-out and every predeclared sparse-observation leave-one-out case, but positive phylogenetic structure was not a preregistered alternative and is not promoted as a new claim.

result_sequence.interpretation: The negative global-style signal weakens to zero and then changes sign as source processing is harmonized and same-pipeline Japan-local coverage expands. This pattern argues against treating the original global overdispersion signal as a Japanese-radiation result.

colour.status: The Japan-local continuous lightness module is now sufficiently stress-tested to stop significance-seeking expansion for the anti-phylogenetic hypothesis. Colour remains biologically important for independent functional/molecular questions, but it is not current evidence for repeated Japan-radiation overdispersion.

priority_reordering.first: Freeze Japan7 and stop acquiring or reprocessing colour observations solely to rescue the anti-phylogenetic lightness hypothesis. New colour sampling is justified only by an independent functional, discrete-state, molecular or field-validation question.
priority_reordering.second: Return the doctoral repeated-evolution mainline to the discrete capitulum modules with stronger historical evidence: orientation, phyllary posture and stickiness. Treat colour as a negative/contrast module rather than forcing it into the same recurrence conclusion.
priority_reordering.third: For orientation/phyllary/stickiness, connect recurrent-state history to the quantitative functional-effect registry/meta-analysis and ask whether repeatedly changing branches map to independently supported ecological benefit/cost axes. Keep causality separate from pattern detection.
priority_reordering.fourth: Absolute-time/event correspondence remains conditional on the unresolved dating gate; do not turn the ~2.4 Ma published radiation statement into a crown calibration. JPN38 permission and JPN29 identity stay as optional colour expansion routes, not current blockers.
priority_reordering.do_not_repeat: Do not lower evidence thresholds, admit one-cell concepts post hoc, remove taxa because they weaken a preferred sign, search alternate colour transforms on the same panel for significance, or reinterpret the descriptive positive tail as preregistered phylogenetic conservatism.

claim_boundary: The source-balanced Japan7 result is strong evidence against replicating the prior global anti-phylogenetic lightness diagnostic in the currently sampled Japanese radiation, not proof that colour never evolves repeatedly or adaptively. The positive observed rho is descriptive, not a post-hoc conservatism claim. No ancestral colour, discrete W/C transition, convergence, adaptive radiation or molecular reactivation is inferred.
